turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Of course. First, one example solved step by step.
"You walk fast." Now I change "you" to "she".
Step 1: the subject is "she".
Step 2: she is one person, so I add -s: "She walks fast."
So, after he, she or it, put -s on the verb.
Right: It works now. Wrong: It work now.

Now try this one. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
